lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: The Tree stirs - a spirit answers. It will gather for Elarion, even while you are away.

lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: Word travels in Elarion. What do you need, defender?

lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: The light fails at the realm's edge. Few return who chase it.

lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: If you mean to, the board has the threads. Mind the dark.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: Welcome to the Echo Hollow. The echoes here seek a bond. Choose one and it will fight at your side, guard Elarion, and return to you always.

options.text: A frost-warden - the Ice Wolf. Steady and tough.
The Ice Wolf already walks with you.
A hearth-hound - the Flame Pup. Fierce and fast.
The Flame Pup already walks with you.
A heart-ward - the Aether Sprite. Quick and arcane.
The Aether Sprite already walks with you.
I'll return when I can take another.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Ice Wolf is attuned to you. It will chill any foe that nears the Heart.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Ice Wolf is already bonded to you - it answers your call when you need it.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Flame Pup answers your call. Its embers will scorch the enemy.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Flame Pup is already bonded to you - its embers are yours to command.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Aether Sprite flits to your side. It will ward the Heart with arcane light.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Aether Sprite is already bonded to you - its arcane light is ever at your side.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: Welcome back. Your echo already walks with you - the bond is whole. When your bond can hold another, the echoes will be waiting.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The hollow is always open when you are ready.

dialogues._note: WO-854 Phase 3 (2026-08-04, owner ruling 'retarget onto what ships'). The StartQuest/SetQuestFlag verbs on node 'accept' and the CompleteQuest on the command-only node 'accept_close' all named quest id 'companion.sylas', which is not in quests.json - QuestService.StartQuest logs the unknown id and returns, so the beat played and no quest state moved. RESOLUTION = REMOVE, not repoint: the companion recruitment thread is RETIRED under ff.singlehero (default ON), and this node's only two hosts (SylasFirstMeeting.cs ShouldRun and CastleCompanionIntroducerInjector.Bootstrap) both stand down when that flag is on, so the beat is unreachable in the shipping build. No shipped quest serves a companion recruitment thread, so there was nothing honest to repoint at. Prose and the RecruitCompanion verb are untouched - the beat still plays intact with ff.singlehero OFF. Node 'accept_close' was deleted because it carried the CompleteQuest and nothing else; 'accept' is now terminal, the same shape as the sibling 'decline' node.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Hold - easy. Keep your hand off that hilt; if I wanted you down you'd not have heard me at all.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I've had eyes on you since the treeline. You're the new Keeper. The Heart's been louder since you came - even out here I felt it stir.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Sylas. Scout of the Reach. I've read these woods longer than the Hollow Ones have walked them.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I knew the people who gave themselves to that tree. Some of those Echoes were friends. So I keep the wild off the wall, and I don't ask for thanks.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Watching. There's a difference, and you'll learn it. A scout who follows gets seen. A scout who watches keeps you alive.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I'm Sylas - Scout of the Reach. And I don't trail just anyone through these trees.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: The wild's been restless. Something past the dark side of this land is pushing them toward Elarion - the Hollow Ones first, and worse behind them.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I can read a trail three days cold. You can hold a wall. Apart, we each lose slow. Together, maybe we don't.

options.text: Why should I trust a stranger in the woods?

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: You shouldn't. Not on my word. So trust the arrow - I'll put one in whatever finds us first, and you can decide what I'm worth after.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: He lowers the bow, and something in his shoulders eases. Then it's settled. I walk where you walk, Keeper - and I put an arrow in whatever finds us first.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Stay near the wall when the horns sound. Out here, I'll go first - I always have.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Lead on. Let's see what the dark side of this land is hiding.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Suit yourself. Proud gets you killed out here, but it's your wall to bleed for.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: He fades back toward the trees. I'll be in the treeline when you change your mind, Keeper. You will.

dialogues._note: WO-854 Phase 3 (2026-08-04, owner ruling 'retarget onto what ships'). Node 'charge' fired StartQuest/SetQuestFlag/CompleteQuest all naming quest id 'companion.sylas', which is not in quests.json - a silent no-op dressed as progress. RESOLUTION = REMOVE, not repoint. This beat is still REACHABLE (CompanionMeetingTrigger does not check ff.singlehero, so it hosts on the 'Play Intro' non-fast-path route), but read the prose: 'charge' is the FTUE orientation brief about the Heart and holding the line, not a recruitment contract - the quest verbs are leftovers of the retired companion framing. Repointing them at the shipped onboarding quest elarion.welcome would be strictly WORSE than the bug: the node fires Start and Complete together, and CompleteQuest jumps a quest straight to Completed without paying any stage reward or granting the keystone, so it would burn 'A New Defender' (both stages, 150 crystals, 20 food, the keystone) before the player ever met the Elder or survived a wave. The RecruitCompanion verb is left alone - it is not a quest verb and it is the ff.singlehero-OFF restore path.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: You made it to the wall. Good. I'm Sylas - Scout of the Reach. I've kept the wild off these stones since long before you came.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: The Heart's been louder since you arrived, Keeper. That's not nothing - it means the light still answers someone.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Here is the shape of it: drive the dark back from the Heart and the tree grows. A brighter Heart is a stronger Heart - and the echoes gather more for you while you fight.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: When the horns sound, hold the line. I'll take the treeline. Let's see what the dark side of this land is hiding.

lines.speaker: Mother Wren
lines.text: Come in out of the wind, dearie. There is bread, and there is always a chair.

lines.speaker: Mother Wren
lines.text: Get my stones turning again. Empty bellies, empty walls - it has never been more complicated than that.

lines.speaker: Old Pell
lines.text: Mind where you put your boots, Keeper. Young roots under there, and they have had a hard century.

lines.speaker: Old Pell
lines.text: The grove I grew up in has gone grey to the bark. Lift whatever is sitting on it and I will get the saws singing again.

lines.speaker: Arcanist
lines.text: The runes hum louder since you came, Keeper. The Heart's light feeds them, and through them the towers see far.

lines.speaker: Arcanist
lines.text: When you would deepen the weave, the tower stands ready to learn.

lines.speaker: Drillmaster
lines.text: Recruits sharpen by the hour, Keeper. Give the word and they'll march - Elarion's walls won't hold themselves.

lines.speaker: Drillmaster
lines.text: Strengthen the barracks and I'll turn out steadier blades for the line.

lines.speaker: Coppin
lines.text: Fresh stock off the morning carts, Keeper - tools, trinkets, and whatever the caravans dared to carry through the Dimming.

lines.speaker: Coppin
lines.text: Come, have a look before the good pieces go.

lines.speaker: Borin Emberhand
lines.text: Emberhand. Yes, that Emberhand. Mind the broken hilt on the anvil - it does not move.

lines.speaker: Borin Emberhand
lines.text: A thousand honest swords, Keeper. Not one great one. That is the bargain I keep.

lines.speaker: Halvard
lines.text: Plate, mail, and good boiled leather, Keeper - armor that holds when the wall does not.

lines.speaker: Halvard
lines.text: Step in and let's fit you proper.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Careful hands, Keeper - everything on this bench remembers a purpose. Rings, amulets, stones that still hold a little light.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Come, look closer.

lines.speaker: Herbalist
lines.text: Mind the fumes, Keeper - every tincture on this bench is a small argument with the Dimming.

lines.speaker: Herbalist
lines.text: Bring me herbs and I'll bring you back from anything. Step up to the bench.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Careful hands, Keeper - everything on this bench remembers a purpose. Rings, amulets, stones that still hold a little light.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Step up to the bench and we'll set a stone together.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: In town they come in WAVES, at the gates. Your towers hold the line - and you fight beside them.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Horns! Here they come - to the gate, Keeper!

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: The line held - you and that tower of yours, together. That is how home is kept.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Take your due - a defender earns their keep.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: You are ready to defend Elarion. When you wish to venture beyond the walls, the road is yours to take. You can revisit this guide anytime under Settings, Game Guide.

dialogues._note: WO-1014 2a SALVAGE. The retired legacy arc's one genuinely useful teach - the town-vs-open-world distinction, formerly tut_return_home ('Two fights, Keeper') - re-voiced as the {guide} pet-Echo so the WISDOM survives the SPEAKER's retirement. NOT WIRED YET: no step in tutorial-steps.json triggers it, because the trigger signal (first time the player leaves the walls / first open-world encounter) is an OWNER CREATIVE PIN - WO-1014 section 5 lists it. Wire it to a contextual one-shot the moment she rules the trigger; do not invent one.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Mark this, Keeper. In town they come in waves, at your gates, and your towers stand with you.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Beyond the walls there are no towers - only you and me. Two fights. Always know which one you are in.

dialogues._note: WO-1014 2c ORDERING FIX: the guide's UTILITY line ('I can farm. I can mend.') now lands HERE, in beat 1/8, BEFORE any ask - it used to be buried as the third line of tut_founding_hollow_done and (after WO-1012's re-author) sat in tut_founding_ack, both of which play AFTER the player has already been told to build. Owner report 2026-08-10, verbatim: 'the wolf asks what to do, but never explained that's what it does'. || OWNER CREATIVE PIN (WO-1014 2b / section 5, NOT authored by CLI): the guide's SELF-INTRODUCTION beat - the name it gives and whether it introduces itself BEFORE or AFTER the tree line - is the owner's call. lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: This is your castle - and this tree is what we defend. Everything else is yours to build.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: The old town is gone, Keeper. What stands next on this ground is your call, stone by stone.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: I can farm. I can mend. Put me to work, Keeper.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Start small. Tap BUILD and set down an Echo Hollow - anywhere you like. There is no wrong ground for it.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Build a thing, and the thing gives back. You'll see.

dialogues._note: SUPERSEDED + UNREFERENCED: no step in tutorial-steps.json names tut_founding_hollow / _done / tut_founding_town / tut_founding_echo since WO-1012's P3 arc re-author (verified 2026-08-10 - the mandatory chain is greet -> walk -> stores -> ack -> defense -> timers -> defend -> win). WO-1014 2c stripped the buried UTILITY line that used to sit here as line 3 (after the ask) - it now opens the arc in tut_founding_greet. Kept, not deleted: still valid copy if the Hollow beat is ever re-armed, and it must NOT re-acquire the utility line.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: There - your Hollow stands, and your first Echo has answered. That spirit is yours now, Keeper.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: You'll find it under the Echoes button by the tree - it works for you now.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: This one earns its keep. Some roofs work your land - grain, timber, coin - and a lumber yard turns the woods into planks.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Set your stores wherever the ground suits you. The raiders march on the Heart of Elarion - they pay your storehouses no mind.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Walls and towers are what hold a horde back. We'll raise those next - that is where your defense is won.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Now the rest - the forge, the farm, the market. Lay them out; this town is yours.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Take your time. A town is a plan you walk through every day.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Your first Echo has woken - a spirit of the tree, and it came with your Hollow.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Open the Echoes button by the tree to meet it, and choose what it gathers - wood, iron or grain. While you rest, it works.

nodes._note: WO-702: gathering only in player copy for now. When WO-701 (offline structure repair) ships, the copy pass adds the repair-while-away line here.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Roofs raised - now teeth. Open BUILD and look to the Defenses tab.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Raise a tower where your walls are weakest. When the horde comes, you'll be glad of every arrow.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: A new Echo has answered! Set it to a harvest - wood, iron or grain - and it will tend the work on its own.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Coin enough to build, Keeper. Walls don't raise themselves - put it to work.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: New steel in your pack? Iron serves no one in a chest - equip it.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: A talent point is yours, Keeper. Open Hero, then Skills, and spend it on something you can use.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 P3 beat 2/8 WALK ('Come with me.' - the WO's authored copy). No control text: the walk itself teaches joystick/camera (progressive disclosure law).

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Come with me, Keeper - the gate first. Stay close; I will show you the way.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 P3 beat 4/8 ACK: the acknowledgment beat (2b piece 6). Supersedes tut_founding_hollow_done as the chain's first acknowledgment (that record is now unreferenced by the mandatory chain). WO-1014 2c MOVED the utility line ('I can farm. I can mend.') OUT of this beat and into tut_founding_greet: an ACK plays AFTER the player has already built, so stating the guide's utility here still landed after the ask - the exact defect the owner reported on 2026-08-10. The Echo-system hook now opens the arc instead.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Good. You got it. Build a thing, and the thing gives back.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 P3 beat 6/8 TIMERS: ONE line on the queue chip, no lecture (the Manage deep-dive stays contextual).

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Work takes time, Keeper. Watch the ledger - the Builders tally tells you what is still rising.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 P3 beat 8/8 WIN + HANDOFF outro (the WO's authored line). Its dialogue.ended raise is the 2c-bis nudge chain's trigger - consumed by no mandatory step, so it reaches the contextual watchers.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: The rest is yours, Keeper.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 2c-bis nudge 1/2 (owner 2026-08-10): the weapons building - catalog id 'forge', role 'weaponsmith', display 'Forge'. CORRECTED 2026-08-23 (WO-1161 follow-up): the id used to read 'workshop' here, which is the crafting station and sells nothing; vendors.json says 'forge' sells weapons. lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: A thought, Keeper: a town needs proper steel. Set up a spot to buy weapons - raise the Forge, the weaponsmith's roof, when you are ready.

dialogues._note: WO-1012 2c-bis nudge 2/2: armor - catalog id 'armorer', role 'armorer', display 'Armorer'. CORRECTED 2026-08-23 (WO-1161 follow-up): this used to name id 'forge', which is the WEAPONS shop - it only read correctly while the catalog labels were crossed. The line below is unchanged. The chain's order past these two beats is an owner creative pin - do not author more without her sequence.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Good steel wants good armor. An Armorer next, perhaps - in your own time, Keeper.

dialogues._note: WO-1378 beat 1/3. Creative canon section 8.1, transcribed verbatim - not paraphrased and not invented. Speaks as {guide} because TutorialGuideIdentityRegression Case 2 [one-speaker] fails any tut_* line spoken by anything else. CARRIES THE CANON'S FIRST TWO MOMENTS IN ONE RECORD: contextual beats cannot be chained off each other (TutorialFlow.cs:1515-1523 returns before TryTriggerContextual at :1526), so a second beat keyed on this record's dialogue.ended would never fire. The two moments coincide anyway - StarterArmyGrant grants the free squad (DefaultStarterCount x troop-footman, WO-1374) the first time a save has a Barracks. The third line is the route, in the SAME words StarterArmyGrant.GrantToastFor and the Game Guide already use.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Your Barracks stands ready. Elarion can now raise soldiers to venture beyond the Heart's protection.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Three Footmen answer the call. Your first company is ready to march.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Open Journey, then Raids, when you are ready to march.

dialogues._note: WO-1378 beat 3/3 - the first-raid prompt, creative canon section 8.1. THIS IS THE SENTENCE THE SHIPPING GAME HAS NEVER SAID: nothing anywhere told a player that raiding is how Elarion gets richer. The old Guide opener was "Raids are where your trained troops earn their keep" - a line about payroll, and the closest thing the game had to a motive. The second line carries the route in WORDS (the owner is red/green colourblind, and there is no Journey highlight id registered to point with).

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Beyond the Heart lie hostile camps holding resources Elarion needs. Break their defences and bring those resources home.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Every victory opens the road farther. Choose your target - stronger footholds carry greater risk and richer spoils.

dialogues._note: WO-1389 - the post-FIRST-RAID beat, WHY half (owner 2026-09-04 23:25: a dialogue screen with images, no world actor; 23:27: introduce why to upgrade and how). Three panels, each one image + one sentence + one door. IMAGES: the portrait command is fired by a lines-less setup node (img1/img2/img3) whose next is the panel, because DialogueRunner.PostLines runs a node's commands AFTER its lines - a portrait command on the panel node itself would change the image only as the panel closed. All three sprites are textureType Sprite in Resources (DataRegression.CheckDialogueSpeakers loads every portrait path). DOORS: an option whose goto is a commands-only node (the brom_intro open_board pattern) - the node fires the verb and the dialogue ends. Next/Later keep the player in the screen. LIVE TOKENS: every number is a {token} resolved at surface time (DialogueTextTokens <- PostRaidBeatTokens) - army fill from ArmyReadiness.Compute (the raid gate's own snapshot), the Footman line from BarracksProgression.NextAbilityLine (the same composer the Troops card paints), the camp sentence from RaidSelectionVM.NextLockedCamp + ScoutLine (the same lock and scout line the raid grid shows). The WO's draft copy said stone walls, 12 defenders for a camp whose data reads Iron / 15 - authoring the number would have shipped that drift. Voice: plain HUD voice pending owner Q1; speaker stays {guide} (TutorialGuideIdentityRegression Case 2). Pinned by tutorial-reach Case 8 [post-raid-beat] (e): 3 lines, 3 doors, 3 images, every token registered, every verb routed.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Your first raid is done. Army {army.used} / {army.cap} - train {army.missing} more to fill your ranks.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Levels change what a troop can do. Footman {footman.next} - and upgrading costs only time.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: {camp.next.line}. Every win opens the road farther.

dialogues._note: WO-1415 - THE INTRODUCTION. Nothing in the game had ever said what Heartfire is: grep -ci 'heartfire' returned ZERO across this file, tutorial-steps.json and guide-content.json, while the HUD plate printed the word and WO-1379 made it the ONE gate on raiding. ONE panel, ONE sentence, ONE door - the tut_ctx_post_raid shape at its smallest. THE SENTENCE IS THE OWNER'S RULING, VERBATIM: 'each one sends you on a raid' (DeNelle.Core.State.HeartfireCharges.SpendSentence; HeartfireRegression PIN H asserts this record and the guide entry both still carry it). IMAGE: the portrait command rides a lines-less setup node because DialogueRunner fires a node's commands AFTER its lines - the same reason tut_ctx_post_raid has img1/img2/img3 - and the sprite is one already proven to load (tut_ctx_post_raid img3 uses it; DataRegression.CheckDialogueSpeakers loads every portrait path). DOOR: an option whose goto lands on a commands-only node (the brom_intro open_board pattern), firing the OpenRaids verb added to DialogueCommandSink for this beat - it calls RaidSelectionScreen.Open, which is the ONE door that asks the WO-1374 capability gate first, so the beat can never hand a player a camp list they may not use. 'Later' goes to 'end', which is deliberately not a node: an unresolved goto ends the dialogue, the same convention tut_ctx_post_raid's Later option uses. NO LIVE TOKENS: the count and the interval are tunables but this copy states the SHIPPED defaults, which HeartfireRegression A0 pins - a retune that changed them would red that pin before it reached a player. Speaks as {guide} and nothing else (TutorialGuideIdentityRegression Case 2). Voice is the plain HUD voice.

lines.speaker: {guide}
lines.text: Heartfire is the Heart's strength beyond its own reach. You hold three, and each one sends you on a raid - one rekindles every four hours.

lines.speaker: Bryn
lines.text: No one walks the cottage dark. Take a torch - and mind it burning.

lines.speaker: Bryn
lines.text: Your light feeds on oil and burns down as you walk. When the flame gutters, stand at the glowing oil stones - they fill it back up.

lines.speaker: Bryn
lines.text: The deep rooms eat the unlit. Come back to me if your light dies.

lines.speaker: Village Elder
